A1_odd_probe_dipole_vanishes.detail: k^0 (uniform) coefficient of D_k is identically zero about the COM

A2_odd_probe_octupole.detail: D_k = -(k^2/6) q3 z^3 + O(k^4), q3 = mu_red (m_h - m_c)/M

A6_equal_mass_exact_sum_zero.detail: m_c=m_h: every odd matrix element cancels

A7_medium_rho_k_no_internal_dipole.detail: rho_k = e^{ikR}[M + 0*k - (k^2/2) mu_red z^2 + ...]: first internal coupling is the quadrupole

A8_medium_alpha_int_order_k2.detail: chi_int = -n k^4 T/(2 w^4) -> alpha_int = n k^2 T/(2 w^4) -> 0

B1_single_Jeans_root.detail: one positive root k_J^2; TF limit k*^2 = 2 pi G/K; root = 2*(-K*rho + sqrt(rho)*sqrt(2*pi*G*tau + K**2*rho))/tau

B3_dressed_perfect_screening_below_kJ.detail: chi_p/eps = +k^2/(4 pi G) + O(k^4) (unstable branch): drho = -rho_ext, total density perturbation -> 0

B4_limit_order_proper.detail: lim_k->0 chi/k^2 = rho/omega**2 (free fall); static chi(k,0)=chi_p; lim_k->0 chi(k,0)/k^2 = -oo

B5_limit_order_dressed.detail: dressed: lim_k->0 chi/k^2 = 2*rho/(8*pi*G*rho + 2*omega**2); then w->0: 1/(4*pi*G) (homogeneous background collapse/swindle branch, not a static stable state)

C1_mode_family_exponent.detail: alpha ~ k^(2a-2-b); internal modes a>=2 (EP) need b=2a-2>=2: a gap closing like k^2 at the probe scale; a=1 at finite gap is the pinned COM (external anchor)

C2_critical_limits_noncommuting.detail: internal quadrupole family: lim_k lim_Omega = oo, lim_Omega lim_k = 0

D1_supported_dielectric_normalization.detail: 4 pi G alpha = 3 rho_c/rho_h  (rho_c = n m_c, rho_h host core)

D2_hard_wall_saturation_scale.detail: g* = w^2 R_c = G M_core/R_c^2 (core surface gravity); p_sat/g* = alpha, so the target needs rho_c = rho_h/3 AND a0 = G M_core/R_c^2 -- state selections

D3_compressible_support_fails.detail: with site compressibility C_site>0: 4 pi G(-chi)/k^2 -> oo (k->0); only C_site=0 (incompressible static support) passes

D4_displacement_over_radius.detail: deep regime, flat curve: |u|/r = rho_dyn/rho_carrier; locality (|u|<<r) requires carrier density >> total dynamical density

E1_target_is_exact_marginality.detail: target quadratic medium energy K|P|^2/2 cancels the Newtonian self-energy at every k: h_target(k) = 4 pi G/k^2

F1_record_n1_cubic_response_reproduced.detail: A=2piE/3, lambda/E=10/pi^2-5/3, COM integral 0, chi_1 = -40/63 + 20/(3*pi**2) = 0.040554 R^7/G (record: 20/(3pi^2)-40/63); plane-probe l=1 part gives chi_k = (k^4/100) chi_1 + O(k^6) per centred object
